validity.recommendation: Do NOT fill StartYear1 with the wiki's '2025' -- that date belongs to a different, unrelated project (the Westbound Compression Expansion Project, target in-service Q4 2025, construction started February 2025), not to the Main Line's own commissioning; the wiki_alignment tool pulled the nearest year token on the page rather than the one tied to this segment. Leave StartYear1 blank for now rather than fill it with a wrong date. This Main Line row (1,868 mi / 3,006 km) is the built-up composite of a system whose earliest predecessor (Mountain Fuel Supply's original interstate gas line out of the Rock Springs, WY discovery) dates to construction beginning in 1929 -- long before FERC eLibrary (which starts ~2001) and long before the pipeline reached anything like its current mileage through decades of Questar/MountainWest-era looping and extension, so 1929 is not a defensible single StartYear1 for the pipe as it exists today and is NOT proposed as a fill. A human researcher should pull Questar Pipeline Co.'s FERC Form 2 filings or its earliest SEC 10-Ks (EDGAR CIK 0000764044, filings back to the 1990s) to establish when the current mainline configuration was placed in service, or decide as a matter of convention that a pre-FERC-eLibrary legacy interstate mainline's Date_logic flag (operating status, no StartYear1) is an expected gap rather than a defect and should be suppressed for this class of row.
validity.researcher_notes: Read the gem.wiki MountainWest Gas Pipeline page for leads only (never cited as a ref, per standing rule 1): its only dated project is the 'Westbound Compression Expansion Project ... Target in-service date of Q4 2025. Construction began in February 2025 ... Proposed in 2023 ... involving infrastructure upgrades on the Overthrust line with a $120 million budget' -- i.e. the page's '2025' is that expansion's in-service date, not the Main Line's, and it is not even on the Overthrust segment covered by this row. Searched for the Main Line's/Mountain Fuel Supply's/Questar Pipeline's original in-service year: company-history sources (referenceforbusiness.com, fundinguniverse.com, company-histories.com -- summarized via search, not cited) describe natural gas discovered near Rock Springs, WY in 1922, Western Public Service Corp incorporated 1928, and pipeline construction 'begun on March 3, 1929 and completed by October' the same year, with Questar Corporation organized as the holding company in 1984. None of these sources ties a specific year to the CURRENT 1,868-mile composite Main Line configuration, and Wikipedia's Questar Pipeline article gives no explicit founding/in-service year either. Given the row spans a century of incremental construction with no single clean commissioning date found, StartYear1 is left UNRESOLVED rather than sourced to a value that would misrepresent a piecemeal system as having one build year.
